---
title: "净胜球阈值截断后：七场组合中奖排名"
format: html
execute:
  cache: false
  freeze: false
  error: false
params:
  project_root: "."
---

使用原四轮七场组合（每轮8个固定场次组合），只为和此前直接对照，不把8组作为新策略要求。来源是冻结FM尾部压缩前base网格。按20/30/40/50/60/70/80/90/95%阈值累计选择高概率净胜球档，边界同概率一起保留，**核心外概率置零，核心内重新归一化**，再映射北单让球W/D/L，按七场类别概率乘积排序、票号破同分。不保留旧允许集合，不复用旧最终概率。固定封存赛果，第二轮未知标签保留待定；实际类别被截掉则为未覆盖而非给一个排名。

```{r}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
root <- normalizePath(params$project_root,mustWork=TRUE)
library(beidan,lib.loc=file.path(root,'r_lib'))
w <- file.path(root,'results/fm17-upcoming-20261017')
f <- readRDS(file.path(w,'frozen-probabilities.rds'));b <- readRDS(file.path(w,'plans.rds'))
s <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(root,'results/margin-ranking-20261017-review/settlement-state.json'))
classification <- readr::read_csv(file.path(root,'results/margin-support-classification-20261017/fixtures.csv'),show_col_types=FALSE)
thresholds <- c(.2,.3,.4,.5,.6,.7,.8,.9,.95)
prob_rows <- list()
ids <- unique(unlist(lapply(b$plans, function(p)p$legs$fixture_id)))
for(id in ids){
 entry <- f$entries[[id]]; h <- unique(f$probabilities$handicap[f$probabilities$fixture_id==id]);stopifnot(length(h)==1,is.finite(h))
 m <- entry$base$grid |> as_tibble() |> mutate(margin=home_goals-away_goals) |> group_by(margin) |> summarise(probability=sum(probability),.groups='drop') |> arrange(desc(probability),margin)
 stopifnot(abs(sum(m$probability)-1)<1e-9,all(m$probability>=0))
 blocks <- m |> group_by(probability) |> summarise(mass=sum(probability),.groups='drop') |> arrange(desc(probability)) |> mutate(cumulative=cumsum(mass))
 for(t in thresholds){
  boundary <- blocks$probability[which(blocks$cumulative>=t)[1]]
  core <- m |> filter(probability>=boundary)
  mass <- sum(core$probability)
  mapped <- core |> mutate(outcome=case_when(margin+h>0~'W',margin+h==0~'D',TRUE~'L')) |> group_by(outcome) |> summarise(probability=sum(probability)/mass,.groups='drop')
  mapped <- tibble(outcome=c('W','D','L')) |> left_join(mapped,by='outcome',relationship='one-to-one') |> mutate(probability=replace_na(probability,0),fixture_id=id,threshold=t)
  original_class <- classification |> filter(fixture_id==id,threshold==t)
  stopifnot(nrow(original_class)==1,sum(mapped$probability>0)==original_class$n_choices,abs(sum(mapped$probability)-1)<1e-12,mass>=t-1e-12)
  prob_rows[[length(prob_rows)+1L]] <- mapped
 }
}
probabilities <- bind_rows(prob_rows)
rows <- list(); pending <- list(); input_files <- c(file.path(w,'frozen-probabilities.rds'),file.path(w,'plans.rds'),file.path(root,'results/margin-ranking-20261017-review/settlement-state.json'))
for(i in 1:4){
 p <- b$plans[[i]];cutoff <- p$selection_receipt$cutoff
 stopifnot(inherits(cutoff$cutoff_utc,'POSIXct'),!is.na(cutoff$cutoff_utc))
 label_path <- file.path(s$run_directory,s$plans$output[i],'results.json');input_files <- c(input_files,label_path)
 actual <- jsonlite::fromJSON(label_path)$fixture_results |> as_tibble() |> select(fixture_id,actual=outcome)
 stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(actual$fixture_id))
 for(g in 1:8){
  legs <- p$legs |> as_tibble() |> filter(group_slot==g) |> arrange(round)
  stopifnot(nrow(legs)==7,n_distinct(legs$fixture_id)==7)
  gl <- legs |> transmute(group_id,fixture_id,leg_order=as.integer(round))
  gid <- unique(legs$group_id);cid <- paste0(gid,'|7')
  for(t in thresholds){
   probs <- probabilities |> filter(threshold==t) |> select(fixture_id,outcome,probability)
   supports <- probs |> filter(fixture_id %in% legs$fixture_id) |> mutate(candidate_id=cid,allowed=probability>0,preference=match(outcome,c('W','D','L'))) |> select(candidate_id,fixture_id,outcome,allowed,preference)
   space <- beidan::parlay_enumerate_tickets(gl,probs,cutoff=cutoff,supports=supports,n_legs=7L)
   ranked <- beidan::parlay_rank_tickets(space$tickets,space$candidate_tickets,cutoff=cutoff,ranking='probability_desc') |> as_tibble()
   sizes <- supports |> group_by(fixture_id) |> summarise(n=sum(allowed),.groups='drop')
   stopifnot(nrow(ranked)==prod(sizes$n),nrow(ranked)<=2187L,!anyDuplicated(ranked$ticket_id),abs(sum(ranked$probability)-1)<1e-9,all(diff(ranked$probability)<=0))
   checked <- space$ticket_legs |> as_tibble() |> left_join(actual,by='fixture_id',relationship='many-to-one') |> group_by(ticket_id) |> summarise(known=sum(!is.na(actual)),misses=sum(!is.na(actual)&outcome!=actual),.groups='drop')
   compatible <- ranked |> left_join(checked,by='ticket_id',relationship='one-to-one') |> filter(misses==0)
   win <- compatible |> filter(known==7);stopifnot(nrow(win)<=1)
   known <- sum(legs$fixture_id %in% actual$fixture_id[!is.na(actual$actual)])
   state <- if(nrow(win))'RANKED' else if(nrow(compatible))'PENDING' else 'EXCLUDED'
   rank <- if(nrow(win))win$rank else NA_integer_
   rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- tibble(round=i,group=g,threshold=t,theory=nrow(ranked),structure=paste(sort(sizes$n,decreasing=TRUE),collapse=''),known,state,winning_rank=rank,possible_rank_min=if(nrow(compatible))min(compatible$rank)else NA_integer_,possible_rank_max=if(nrow(compatible))max(compatible$rank)else NA_integer_,hit_1_125=if(!is.na(rank))rank<=125L else if(state=='PENDING'&&any(compatible$rank<=125L))NA else FALSE,hit_30_154=if(!is.na(rank))rank>=30L&&rank<=154L else if(state=='PENDING'&&any(compatible$rank>=30L&compatible$rank<=154L))NA else FALSE)
   if(state=='PENDING')pending[[length(pending)+1L]] <- compatible |> transmute(round=i,group=g,threshold=t,possible_rank=rank,probability)
  }
 }
}
x <- bind_rows(rows)
stopifnot(nrow(x)==288L,!anyDuplicated(x[c('round','group','threshold')]),all(is.na(x$winning_rank[x$state!='RANKED'])),all(x$winning_rank[x$state=='RANKED']<=x$theory[x$state=='RANKED']))
summary <- x |> filter(round!=2) |> group_by(threshold) |> summarise(groups=n(),covered=sum(state=='RANKED'),excluded=sum(state=='EXCLUDED'),rank_1_125=sum(hit_1_125),rank_30_154=sum(hit_30_154),rank_126_250=sum(winning_rank>=126&winning_rank<=250,na.rm=TRUE),rank_251_500=sum(winning_rank>=251&winning_rank<=500,na.rm=TRUE),rank_501_1000=sum(winning_rank>=501&winning_rank<=1000,na.rm=TRUE),rank_1001_2187=sum(winning_rank>=1001,na.rm=TRUE),.groups='drop')
stopifnot(all(summary$groups==24L),all(summary$covered+summary$excluded==24L),all(summary$covered==summary$rank_1_125+summary$rank_126_250+summary$rank_251_500+summary$rank_501_1000+summary$rank_1001_2187))
for(t in thresholds){
 check <- x |> filter(threshold==t,round!=2)
 stopifnot(all(check$state!='PENDING'))
}
output <- file.path(root,'results/margin-truncated-rank-20261017');dir.create(output,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
readr::write_csv(x,file.path(output,'groups.csv'));readr::write_csv(summary,file.path(output,'summary.csv'));readr::write_csv(probabilities,file.path(output,'conditional-probabilities.csv'));readr::write_csv(bind_rows(pending),file.path(output,'pending-ranks.csv'))
```

已知赛果的第01、03、04轮，共24个七场组合（组间不独立）。区间统计为落入该排名的组数，不是估计命中概率：

```{r}
knitr::kable(summary)
```

逐组中奖排名，未覆盖表示真实类别被核心集合排除，待定表示尚有未知标签：

```{r}
knitr::kable(x |> mutate(result=case_when(state=='EXCLUDED'~'未覆盖',state=='PENDING'~paste0('待定 ',possible_rank_min,'–',possible_rank_max),TRUE~as.character(winning_rank))) |> select(round,group,threshold,result) |> pivot_wider(names_from=threshold,values_from=result))
```

第02轮固定30–154名窗口（不足125种时按实际数量；窗口外不虚构票或支出）：

```{r}
knitr::kable(x |> filter(round==2) |> group_by(threshold) |> summarise(known_hits=sum(hit_30_154,na.rm=TRUE),pending=sum(is.na(hit_30_154)),excluded_or_outside=sum(!hit_30_154,na.rm=TRUE),.groups='drop'))
knitr::kable(tibble(input=input_files,sha256=vapply(input_files,digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')))
```

验收检查：52场×9阈值每场三类别概率归一、支持数与前次分类逐场一致；32个固定组合×9阈值完整唯一；每个组合票数等于允许类别数乘积、无重复、票概率和为1、排名递减、确定结果唯一且在范围内、缺失标签不伪造排名、24组区间计数守恒。不新增函数、不修改包；调用既有已安装包枚举和排序并传入原显式截止。截断后的概率是核心条件分布，不能冒充已校准的无条件实际概率；组间重叠且非独立。本分析是事后政策对照，不据目标赛果选择阈值或窗口，不发布票单、不报告收益。审查/渲染和输入输出SHA记录在results/margin-truncated-rank-20261017/。
